source.name: LONGINES Germany Official Website - GraphQL ProductList API

method: Captured the exact GraphQL 'ProductList' query used by the rendered /de/watches page (via Chrome DevTools MCP network inspection while paginating with the site's own 'Mehr Ergebnisse anzeigen' control), then replayed it in-page via fetch() with pageSize=900 (exceeding total_count) and currentPage=1, headers lang=de-de/store=de_de matching the site's own request headers, to retrieve the full catalog in a single authoritative response instead of paging through 24-item batches.

manualOverridesAndNotes.issue: small_image.label for this SKU followed a different template ('Longines LA GRANDE CLASSIQUE DE LONGINES MONOCHROME Quarz Edelstahl Watch - L4.523.0.50.2') than the standard '<NAME> <SKU> <Movement>, <Case>, <Dial>, <Strap> Watch - Uhren-Soldier' template used by the other 803 items, so the generic comma-based parser could not extract caseDescription/dialDescription for it automatically.
manualOverridesAndNotes.resolution: Opened the product detail page https://www.longines.com/de/p/watch-la-grande-classique-de-longines-l4-523-0-50-2 directly (observed 2026-09-27) and read the rendered German spec text: 'LA GRANDE CLASSIQUE DE LONGINES MONOCHROME, L4.523.0.50.2, Quarz Uhr, Ø 29.00 mm, Edelstahl.' and 'Zifferblatt: Schwarz lackiert, poliert.'. Manually set caseDescription='Ø 29.00 mm, Edelstahl' and dialDescription='Schwarz lackiert, poliert' to match this directly-observed PDP text; this also served as one of the 19-21 independent spot-check items (see validation-summary.json).
manualOverridesAndNotes.alsoObservedOnPdp: Price shown as '3.950,00 €' with the label 'inkl. MwSt' immediately beside it, independently confirming tax-include semantics for the German site.

manualOverridesAndNotes.note: The GraphQL ProductCard fragment exposes a 'tag' field on each item with observed values UNDEFINED (630), NEW (98), BESTSELLER (72), LIMITED_EDITION (4). isNewModel was set to true only when tag == 'NEW', treating this as the official 'new arrival' designation analogous to a 'Neu' badge. BESTSELLER and LIMITED_EDITION were not treated as isNewModel=true. This mapping was not exhaustively cross-checked against a rendered on-page 'Neu' badge for every one of the 98 NEW-tagged items (the accessibility-tree snapshot of the PLP did not expose visible badge text distinct from the tag field), so it is recorded here as an explicit assumption for the coordinator's awareness.

case_material and dial_color on each ProductCard item are opaque numeric attribute-option IDs that do not correspond 1:1 with the human-readable options listed in this same response's 'aggregations' (filter_case_material/filter_dial_color use a different, non-matching ID space). The human-readable case material and dial description text is instead embedded in each item's small_image.label (fallback: thumbnail.label) alt-text field, which follows the template '<NAME> <SKU> <Movement>, <Case material>, <Dial description>, <Strap type> Watch - Uhren-Soldier'. caseDescription was built as case_dimension + ', ' + <case material segment>; dialDescription was built by joining all comma segments between the case-material segment and the final strap+suffix segment (this correctly reproduces multi-part dial descriptions such as 'Schwarz lackiert, poliert'). This parsing method was validated by cross-checking 3 known references (L2.450.4.97.6, L2.962.4.73.2, L3.788.4.70.6) against the already-committed data/markets/longines-switzerland-market.json entries for the same references, which matched byte-for-byte.
